note: CodeWarrior Pro 4 Tools CD, Installer VISE: Custom Install > Full MacOS Install. Run on both machines: the installer adds CFM-68K and NuDragLib on 68k, MathLib on PPC; the merged snapshot has them all. StdCLibInit (PPC before 7.6) is copied from the CD, so one snapshot serves 7.5.5 too. VISE draws its option list itself: the option is clicked by its drawn label and checked by the disk space needed (not an exact size: it differs per machine and target); Install Location is pressed where its current value (the boot disk) is drawn.
